scope: Full read of both frozen files, exact byte hashes, Python AST, YAML structure, exact branch/budget/permissions checks; no execution of the harness, compiler, tests, model, host service or Git reference mutation.
findings: The sole trigger is push to codex/mem8-windows-scoped-fix-b054-20261111-ed353817 and the job independently checks that exact ref; there is no workflow_dispatch.

Harness and frozen source are separate checkouts with credentials disabled. Harness HEAD must equal GITHUB_SHA, tracked/untracked status must be clean, and its actual tree plus driver/workflow digests are recorded.

JOB_ANCHOR binds run ID, attempt, harness SHA and 65-minute original job envelope. The Actions job owns the actual global deadline; no phase resets it and no POSIX supervisor or PID-based process cancellation is introduced.

Windows-native subprocess.run executes exactly the three specified just fix --locked commands, including the qualification-owned-file-read neuron feature. There is no native test or model command and no five-case PASS prerequisite.

The exact source HEAD/tree, complete worktree status including ignored untracked files, both lock hashes, source policy/recipe files and actual pinned compiler/linter/recipe-runner binaries are checked.
Each completed command preserves original raw output, exit status, before/after source and tools, full binary diffs and changed-file postimages. Any nonzero exit or rewrite stops subsequent fixes.
An interrupted run without an observed exit/after receipt remains failed/interrupted or partial. Collection records only an observed snapshot and cannot invent a missing command-exit acknowledgement.
always() artifact retention includes hidden paths; failed setup or collection cannot be represented as three clean scoped fixes.
boundaries: This is static review only; no Windows execution, dependency availability or compiler acceptance is established.
These commands are scoped lint/build checks. Final native acceptance still requires the separately specified five actual cases; no results are inherited from prior source heads.
The first-step timestamp is a budget observation later than actual job start. The Actions timeout remains the authoritative upper bound.
No Git blob publication or workflow admission is performed by this review.
